chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who fell upon another man and killed him, and he said: “There is nothing upon him.”

key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked; introducing the legal inquiry to the Imam
key_terms.شَيْءٌ: anything; meaning no liability or obligation is due upon him in this case
key_terms.فَقَتَلَهُ: and killed him; describing the resulting death
key_terms.لَيْسَ: there is not; negating legal consequence here
key_terms.وَقَعَ: fell; indicating an act of falling rather than deliberate assault

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a person falls on someone and accidentally kills him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a case where a man falls upon another and causes his death. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that no liability is upon him, indicating the absence of culpability in this specific circumstance.
